system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Athletics and Guile, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Trade Routes Lore, Caravans Lore, Lore of a region you traveled.
system.description: You loaded wagons and walked the long miles between settlements. You learned which bargains keep a caravan moving and how to talk your way past a troublesome checkpoint.
